title: Web API Review Deck
description: A compact deck for testing source-grounded card generation.
method_notes: The deck supports what can go wrong and does not replace the system model.

cards.title: Replayable delivery
cards.prompt: Could this message be replayed outside the transaction where it was created?
anti_patterns: Do not infer replayability from the diagram label alone.

source_trace.derivation_notes: The algorithm delivers a result to a recipient callback.

cards.expected_bad_event_shape: A message or callback is replayed or substituted before the receiver acts.

cards.title: Wrong principal
cards.prompt: Could an operation be authorized using the wrong principal or execution context?
anti_patterns: Do not treat a missing control as the threat story.
cards.expected_bad_event_shape: An operation executes with authority belonging to a different principal.

cards.title: Stale state
cards.prompt: Could stale state remain authoritative after its validity or consent has changed?
anti_patterns: Do not assume lifecycle behavior that is absent from the source.

source_trace.source_reference: The model contains stored authorization state.

cards.expected_bad_event_shape: Expired or revoked state continues to authorize an operation.

cards.title: Fail-open fallback
cards.prompt: Could an error or unavailable dependency force the system into a less protected fallback?
anti_patterns: Do not create a threat when the fallback is not modeled; record a model gap.
cards.expected_bad_event_shape: A failure redirects execution to a fallback with weaker checks.
change_notes: Narrowed the prompt to fallback behavior after the first play-test.
